description: Add lightweight authentication and an onboarding questionnaire that profiles the user's optimal learning method. On first login the user answers a set of questions; the app computes a learning-style profile (e.g. VARK-style: visual/auditory/reading-writing/kinesthetic, plus pacing/confidence signals) that later personalizes the study loop. Depends on FEAT-001 (can proceed in parallel with FEAT-002/003 but ordered after them for a stable store layer).
steps: Implement a minimal auth suitable for Vercel + keyless dev: use a signed cookie session (e.g. iron-session or a small JWT signed with AUTH_SECRET) with an email + password stored in the local store (hashed with bcrypt/argon2), OR a simple passwordless 'enter your name/email to create a session' flow if that is simpler and clearly documented. Provide /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout route handlers and a session helper (src/lib/auth). Do not require any external auth provider.

Create src/lib/study/learningProfile.ts: define the questionnaire (a fixed set of ~8-12 questions each mapping to learning-style dimensions) and a scoreProfile(answers) function returning a normalized LearningProfile { visual, auditory, readingWriting, kinesthetic, pace, preferredReviewInterval, dominantStyle }. Keep scoring pure and unit-testable.

Create POST /api/onboarding route: accepts questionnaire answers for the logged-in user, computes the profile via scoreProfile, and persists it to the user's record in the store. GET returns the current profile (or null).
Build the login/register UI (src/app/login/page.tsx) and an onboarding questionnaire UI (src/app/onboarding/page.tsx). After login, if the user has no profile, redirect to onboarding.
Gate the app: unauthenticated users hitting protected pages (upload/books/study) are redirected to /login. Add a session-aware layout/nav showing the user and a logout action.

Add unit tests under src/lib/study/__tests__ and src/lib/auth/__tests__: scoreProfile produces a normalized profile and the expected dominantStyle for representative answer sets; password hashing/verification round-trips; session token sign/verify round-trips.
acceptance_criteria: A user can register, log in, and receive a session cookie; logout clears it.
Submitting onboarding answers persists a LearningProfile retrievable via GET /api/onboarding.
scoreProfile returns normalized dimension scores and a correct dominantStyle for known inputs (unit tested).
Unauthenticated access to protected pages redirects to /login.
All new unit tests pass and `npm run build` succeeds with no external services or AI key.
verification: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run typecheck
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run build
review_fix_findings: Semantic-review pass (2026-08-31): FIXED non-blocking issue #3 (partial questionnaire yields a valid profile). validateAnswers now (a) rejects unknown question/option ids, then (b) requires an answer for EVERY questionnaire item, throwing 'Please answer every question. Missing: ...' otherwise, and (c) resolves options in questionnaire order for determinism. scoreProfile stays pure (it just calls validateAnswers), so POST /api/onboarding already surfaces the message as a 400 via its existing try/catch. The onboarding UI already enforced allAnswered client-side, so no UI change was needed. Updated src/lib/study/__tests__/learningProfile.test.ts to use full answer sets and added explicit 'rejects incomplete questionnaire' / 'accepts complete questionnaire' cases (the old partial-submission and empty-object assertions were replaced). Also, as part of the auth-hardening fix, /api/onboarding was already session-gated; no change there. Keyless verification green: npm test (79), typecheck, lint, build.
findings:
Implemented email+password auth (bcryptjs, pure JS) with HS256 JWT sessions (jose) in an httpOnly `iq_session` cookie. Session sign/verify logic lives in src/lib/auth/token.ts (edge-safe, no next/headers) so it can be reused by both route handlers (via src/lib/auth/session.ts + next/headers) and the route-gating proxy. AUTH_SECRET falls back to a documented dev-only secret when unset so build/tests/dev work keyless; README + .env.example note production must set it. Added deps: bcryptjs, jose, @types/bcryptjs.

Route gating: Next.js 16 deprecates the `middleware` file convention in favor of `proxy` (src/proxy.ts with a default `proxy` export) — used that to avoid the deprecation warning. Gates /upload, /books, /onboarding, /study -> redirect to /login.

User store (src/lib/store/users.ts) mirrors the BookStore globalThis-singleton pattern; same in-memory serverless caveat documented.

learningProfile.ts: fixed 10-question questionnaire; scoreProfile is pure/deterministic returning normalized {visual,auditory,readingWriting,kinesthetic,pace,preferredReviewInterval,dominantStyle}. dominantStyle ties broken by fixed LEARNING_STYLES order.

Test quirk: jose HS256 signing throws 'Received an instance of Uint8Array' under vitest's default jsdom environment (realm-crossed typed arrays fail jose's key check). Fixed by adding `// @vitest-environment node` to src/lib/auth/__tests__/token.test.ts. bcryptjs tests run fine under jsdom.

ESLint react-hooks/set-state-in-effect: onboarding page applies fetch results inside an async .then (mirrors the existing book page). Also replaced window.location.href internal navigations flagged by @next/next/no-location-assign-relative-destination with useRouter().push()/refresh() in LogoutButton and onboarding; login page keeps a full reload (ternary target not statically flagged) so the server NavBar re-reads the new session.

Verification (all pass): npm test (46 tests, 10 files), npm run typecheck, npm run lint (0 warnings), npm run build (14 routes + proxy).
